rows.ja: 電池・半導体の供給元
蓄電・宇宙・AIの取引先
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 電池セルの供給元として実名で記載
relations.text_en: Named as a battery-cell supplier

source.label: Tesla 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Currently, we rely on suppliers such as Panasonic and Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited (CATL) for these cells.
source.note: 上場親会社はPanasonic Holdings(東証6752)です。

relations.text: 電池セルの供給元として実名で記載
relations.text_en: Named as a battery-cell supplier

source.label: Tesla 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Currently, we rely on suppliers such as Panasonic and Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited (CATL) for these cells.

relations.text: AI向け先端半導体を米国で製造する協業を発表
relations.text_en: Announced a collaboration to manufacture advanced AI chips in the U.S.

source.label: Tesla 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: announced a new collaboration with Samsung to manufacture advanced semiconductors for AI inference and training in the U.S.

relations.text: 車内体験向けのプロセッサ・SoCを提供(AMDがTeslaを技術パートナーとして記載)
relations.text_en: Provides processors and SoCs for in-cabin experiences (AMD lists Tesla as a technology partner)

source.label: AMD 車載ソリューションのページ
source.quote: processors and adaptive SoCs powering unique in-cabin experiences from technology partners such as Tesla and Daimler
source.note: 全車種や運転用AI半導体にまで広げて読むことはできません。
source.note_en: Not to be read as covering every model or self-driving chips.

relations.text: SpaceX向けのMegapack売上が2026年6月期の半年で4.05億ドル(第2四半期は3.18億ドル)
relations.text_en: Megapack sales to SpaceX were $405M for the first half to June 2026 ($318M in Q2)

relations.text: 2026年3月、SpaceXの普通株に20億ドルを投資(当時1%未満)
relations.text_en: Invested $2B in SpaceX common stock in March 2026 (under 1% at the time)

source.label: Tesla 10-Q(2026年6月30日終了の四半期)
source.note: 現在の持分比率は推定していません。

relations.text: MacrohardのAI開発とTerafab構想を共同で推進(SpaceXの目論見書)
relations.text_en: Jointly pursuing the Macrohard AI effort and the Terafab plan (SpaceX prospectus)

source.label: SpaceX 目論見書(2026年6月5日)
source.note: 開発・構想の段階の話で、完成した製品や確定した調達量ではありません。
source.note_en: Describes development and plans, not finished products or confirmed purchase volumes.

relations.text: Fluenceが年次報告でTeslaを主要な競合に挙げている
relations.text_en: Fluence names Tesla as a key competitor in its annual report

source.label: Fluence 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: Our key competitors currently include, but are not limited to, Tesla, Inc., Wärtsilä, Sungrow, and Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (“CATL”).

relations.text: Enphaseが年次報告で蓄電市場の競合にTeslaを挙げている
relations.text_en: Enphase names Tesla as a competitor in the storage market in its annual report

source.label: Enphase 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Competitors in the storage market include Tesla, SolarEdge, Huawei, BYD Company Limited (“BYD”), Franklin Solar Battery and other producers of battery cells and integrated storage systems.

relations.text: GMの充電アプリがTesla Superchargerでの充電に対応
relations.text_en: GM’s charging app supports charging at Tesla Superchargers

source.label: GM の発表(2026年8月)
source.quote: Tesla Supercharger, IONNA, Electrify America, and ChargePoint are supported today
source.note: 北米の対象車が対象で、全車種・全拠点が無条件で使えるわけではありません。
source.note_en: Applies to eligible North American vehicles; not every model or site is covered unconditionally.

relations.text: Megapackの購入で、2025年にTeslaが4.3億ドルの売上を計上(関連当事者取引)
relations.text_en: Tesla recognized $430M of revenue in 2025 from xAI’s Megapack purchases (related-party transaction)

source.label: Tesla 10-K(2025年度)(注記15)
source.quote: we recognized $ 430 million of revenues and $ 285 million of cost of revenues from xAI for its purchase of our Megapack products in the ordinary course of business.
source.note: 関連当事者との取引です。xAIはその後SpaceXと統合されたと、Teslaの10-Qにあります。
source.note_en: Related-party transaction; xAI was later combined with SpaceX per Tesla’s 10-Q.

relations.text: Ford車がTesla Superchargerを使えると発表(2024年春から)
relations.text_en: Ford EV customers gain Tesla Supercharger access (from spring 2024)

source.label: Ford の発表(2024年1月)
source.quote: Last year, Ford announced that its EV customers would gain access to Tesla Superchargers across the U.S. and Canada beginning in Spring 2024.
source.note: 対象車種はアダプター利用で、2025年からNACSポートに移行します。
source.note_en: Eligible models use an adapter; NACS ports from 2025.

relations.text: Rivian車がTesla Superchargerを利用可能に(2024年3月)
relations.text_en: Rivian owners can use the Tesla Supercharger network (March 2024)

source.label: Rivian Stories(2024年3月)
source.quote: Rivian owners now have access to the Tesla Supercharger network and will start receiving NACS DC adapters in April.
source.note: 古い車種はNACS用アダプターが必要です。
source.note_en: Earlier models need a NACS DC adapter.

relations.text: 北米向けEVで2025年からNACS採用でTeslaと合意(2023年9月発表)
relations.text_en: Agreed with Tesla to adopt NACS on North American EVs from 2025 (announced September 2023)

source.label: Honda の発表(2023年9月)
source.quote: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. today announced that it has reached an agreement with Tesla, Inc. to adopt Tesla's North American Charging Standard (NACS) for the charging port of its EV models
source.note: 発表時点の将来計画です。

relations.text: 2025年からNACS採用でTeslaと合意(2023年7月発表)
relations.text_en: Agreed with Tesla to adopt NACS from 2025 (announced July 2023)

source.label: Nissan USA の発表(2023年7月)
source.quote: Nissan has reached an agreement with Tesla to adopt the North American Charging Standard (NACS) beginning in 2025, providing Nissan customers even more choices when it comes to charging their electric vehicle.
source.note: 発表時点の将来計画です。

relations.text: 北米向けのバッテリーEVで2025年からNACS採用でTeslaと合意(2023年10月発表)
relations.text_en: Agreed with Tesla to adopt NACS on its battery EVs from 2025 (announced October 2023)

source.label: Toyota USA ニュースルーム(2023年10月)
source.quote: Toyota Motor North America, Inc. (TMNA) today announced it has reached an agreement with Tesla, Inc. to adopt the North American Charging Standard (NACS) on its battery electric vehicles (BEVs) beginning in 2025.
source.note: 発表時点の将来計画です。

relations.text: Lucid車が2025年1月31日からTeslaの充電網を利用可能(Lucidの年次報告)
relations.text_en: Lucid customers gained access to Tesla’s Supercharger network on January 31, 2025 (Lucid annual report)

source.label: Lucid 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 31, 2025, our customers gained access to Tesla’s supercharging network in addition to the vast CCS infrastructure
source.note: Airはアダプター利用、Gravityは最初からNACSポート付きです。
source.note_en: Air uses an adapter; Gravity has a native NACS port.

relations.text: SolarEdgeの年次報告が、北米の住宅用インバーターの競合としてTeslaを挙げている
relations.text_en: SolarEdge’s annual report names Tesla as a competitor in North American residential solar inverters

source.label: SolarEdge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we compete with manufacturers such as Tesla Inc. with traditional string-based solutions
source.note: 北米の住宅用に限った記載です。
source.note_en: Limited to the North American residential market.

relations.text: Eos Energyの年次報告が、競合としてTeslaを挙げている
relations.text_en: Eos Energy’s annual report names Tesla among competitors

source.label: Eos Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our Znyth ™ battery system competes with products from traditional Li-ion battery manufacturers and solution providers such as Fluence Energy, Panasonic, Samsung Electronics Co. Ltd., LG Chem Ltd., Tesla, BYD, Sungrow and Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited.

relations.text: Albemarleの年次報告が、リチウム化合物の主要な競合としてTeslaを挙げている
relations.text_en: Albemarle’s annual report lists Tesla among major competitors in lithium compounds

source.label: Albemarle 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Major competitors in lithium compounds include Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile S.A., Sichuan Tianqi Lithium, Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium, Rio Tinto plc, Pilbara Minerals, Tesla
source.note: Teslaが自社で行う精製との競合です。

note.ja: 公式の発表と提出書類(10-K・10-Q・20-F・8-K・目論見書)で確認できた関係だけを載せています。公式資料で確認できなかった関係は載せていません。この図は情報の整理を目的としており、特定の銘柄の売買を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official announcements and filings (10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 8-K and prospectuses) are shown. Relationships that could not be confirmed in official materials are left out. This diagram is for organizing information and is not a recommendation to buy or sell any stock.
